reviews.t: Great for all lovers of makeup and health
reviews.x: I wear eyeliner every single day and I love to wear it thickly. One thing I don't love is all the exposure of random chemicals to my eyeballs. I figured there had to be healthier alternatives and I came across this! At first, it took some practice to get used to working with the formula, it tends to dry much quicker than non-natural eyeliner, but I love the results. This eyeliner seriously causes no irritation and I am excited to use this everyday!

reviews.t: I gave up a refund to write this review
reviews.x: Brush is a solid piece, not bristles so it takes some getting used to. It does stay on well but a that said it's impossible to take off with makeup remover, oil,  moisturizer or soap. reviews.t: Great! Except for us with no fine-coordination

It doesn't smudge or run (and I have sweat while wearing it) but I have officially decided that liquid eyeliner is NOT for me. I will stick with the pencils. If your hand has better control than my hand - this product is absolutely for you.

reviews.t: Very good item.
reviews.x: This is a very good product. I love that the item is organic. Once applied, it stays for the entire day. I use NYR Organic Makeup Remover to remove it nightly. My only complaint is that the felt like tip is very stiff and can make it difficult to smoothly go over the curve of the eyelid. Even so, I would highly recommend this product. https://us.nyrorganic.com/shop/Sabrina_Thomas/area/shop-online/category/cleansers/product/1799/organic-eye-make-up-remover-3-38-fl-oz/

reviews.t: Although I am EXTREMELY pleased with this company's blush
reviews.x: Although I am EXTREMELY pleased with this company's blush, foundation and mascara, I am disappointed in the eyeliner. For me, the brush could not supply a thin enough line that I am used to. My MAJOR complaint though, is it flakes after several hours. I am comparing it to my Physicians Formula Eye Liner which I am very pleased with but would prefer to use an all natural product.

reviews.t: Does not irritate my eyes, stay on all day, just don't know how to effectively remove it completely
reviews.x: My eyes are very sensitive, this eyeliner doesn't irritate my eyes at all.  I overall really like it, as it also stays on for the whole day.  The one thing I can't figure how out to effectively take it off. I use water-proof makeup remover to remove it; but eyeliner does not come off completely.  What's the most effective way to remove this eyeliner??

reviews.t: Great Product
reviews.x: So I purchased this product as I enjoy wearing eyeliner on occasions. However, I have had irritation problems. This eyeliner does not irritate. It stays on well, but requires a good rag to scrub off. It is not hard to apply, but you do have to have a steady hand. It was also delivered in a very timely manner, so I was glad to try it our right away.

reviews.t: I think this product is great!!
reviews.x: I think this product is great!!! If you want a dramatic/darker look, this does the trick. I just don't have a steady hand, so I need more practice applying this.  Using this in conjuction with the eye pencil helps.  The owner is great and really cares about offering cosmetically safe products to his customers too which is another HUGE PLUS!

reviews.t: Very nice product. It took a little bit of practice
reviews.x: Very nice product.  It took a little bit of practice, but it does stay on even through working out. I'm talking an hour of CrossFit and an hour of jiu-jitsu in one day. I love that it's made of natural ingredients.  Tip: put a thin, but dark layer on quickly. It dries very fast!

reviews.x: A bit hard to apply on top lid (maybe because the shape of my eye requires a curve) but what I really like about it is I have a watery eye issue, and the liner under the eye seems to stay put better than my liquid liner, while still lmaintaining the look of a liquid liner.

reviews.t: I like this product
reviews.x: I like this product, but the application brush is not very easy to use. Maybe I am just adjusting to the new product, but I have definitely enjoyed more of a brush than a stiff tip applicator. The liner itself is very dark and easy to remove and reapply, if necessary.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the applicator tip stiff or too thick, making it difficult to apply precisely.
Several reviewers report eye irritation or difficulty applying without irritation.
Reviewers praise the natural/organic formula and its long-lasting, smudge-resistant wear.
Some reviewers find the eyeliner hard to remove, even with makeup remover, oil, or soap.
A few reviewers note the product is expensive and doesn't last long or is unavailable.
